result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/q929-vortex-8d-corrective-action-subprocess.md. EMPIRICAL RESULT: a throwaway DB-backed probe (deleted; git status clean of it) loaded the real parent fixture with definition_name='8D Corrective Action' plus a START->HUMAN_TASK(role-procurement-manager)->END child. Sub-process spawn works (child ACTIVE at corrective-action-8d). After the child task was completed the observed output was: 'parent after child complete: {:active, ["close-deviation"]}', 'parent dispatches: [{"quarantine-batch", "advanced"}]', 'parent tokens: [{"close-deviation", :active}]' -- i.e. NO service_task_dispatches row for close-deviation, the parent is stuck ACTIVE and can never reach end-closed/COMPLETED. The suspected defect is CONFIRMED: SubProcess.build_completion_multi_from_merge discards pending events (_pending_events and _more_pending) so SERVICE_TASK/TIMER/escalation arms after a SUB_PROCESS are never persisted. Fixture-only fix is insufficient. DESIGN: (1) fixtures: new test/fixtures/qa/vortex_8d_corrective_action_definition.json (not *_process_definition.json, to dodge TC-0930-01), parent v1.1->1.2 with definition_name attribute; (2) seed_vortex_definition.sh seeds 8D before parent + header; seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh adds role-procurement-manager (5 roles) and felix mapping; (3) drift test: add child fixture, count 4->5, remove refute, rewrite M2 to inverse (missing_in_script); (4) alias sidecar proc-vortex-8d-corrective-action.yaml; simulation yaml parity optional, no sim binding exists; (5) MINIMAL lib change: keep both pending-event lists in build_completion_multi_from_merge, pass to build_completion_write_steps, which appends timer-arm and service-task-dispatch Multi steps after token reconciliation via ONE new @doc false public Engine.append_pending_event_arms_multi/7 wrapping the existing private prepare_timer_arms/prepare_service_task_dispatch_abort_on_empty_url/build_*_multi helpers; errors map to existing activation_failed ExecutionError channel. No authz/tenant-derivation change (tenant id from schema prefix as complete_task does), so SECURITY-REVIEWER may be skipped on that basis only; REVIEWER required. (6) tests: pure fixture test F1-F7 and DB-backed sub_process_service_task_after_test E1-E6 (E1/E6 fail on unfixed tree) with mutation targets. Known out-of-scope gap: a second SUB_PROCESS directly after a completed SUB_PROCESS is still not spawned (ORCH to file follow-up). No QA data change. Not self-reviewed.

issues.description: Confirmed engine defect: Letflow.Engine.SubProcess.build_completion_multi_from_merge discards pending events, so a SERVICE_TASK, TIMER or escalation HUMAN_TASK directly after a SUB_PROCESS never gets its dispatch/timer row and the parent is stuck ACTIVE. Requires the minimal lib change in design section 3; ELIXIR-DEV must write fail-first E1 first.
Out of scope, follow-up for ORCH: a second SUB_PROCESS directly after a completed SUB_PROCESS (pending {:sub_process_start,...} in the cascade) is still not spawned.
Handoff started_at was null on receipt; left null per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL 1.2. Post-fix COMPLETED outcome is not observed yet; asserted by E1/E6 for ELIXIR-DEV to run.
